text.content:
Roll (Trait + Skill) six-sided dice. Every 5 or 6 is a Mark. Compare your marks to the difficulty in M. Meet or beat it and you succeed.

Surplus marks are boons, spent immediately. They cannot be banked.

Difficulty never falls below 1M. A test eased below 1M is rolled at 1M and grants 1 bonus boon per point of the reduction that was lost, if it succeeds.
One ally may assist, adding half their score in the tested skill, rounded up. Assist dice are part of your pool and may be rerolled when you strain.
Once per test a Delver may reroll any number of dice, then takes 1 MIND damage. You may strain a test you have already passed, to fish for boons. NPCs cannot strain.

BODY damage is reduced by armor unless it is piercing. MIND and WILL damage always bypasses armor. A creature's single pool takes MIND and WILL damage as piercing BODY damage.

0 damage: blistered by new shoes. 1: slashed by a knife. 2: hit by a sledgehammer. 3: crushed by a building.

When damage reduces a trait's health to 0, roll a recovery test: WILL + SURVIVAL at 2M, +1M if unwarded in the Unknown, and +1M per point of overwhelming damage.

Succeed and heal that trait to 1. Fail and you manifest a random malignant adaptation and gain critical.
Assist, Attack, Brace, Dash, Direct, Grapple, Hide, Repel, Search, Shove.
Move, Equip, Pass, Shine, Break Grapple, Stand Up.

Flurry (1 boon): strike again with another equipped weapon, once per turn.

Cleave (2 boons): with a heavy weapon, deal weapon damage to another creature in the target's zone.

Deadly (2 boons): +1 damage on this attack.

A round is 10 seconds. A segment is 8 hours, three to a day: morning, afternoon, night. A sixday is 6 days; a month is 4 sixdays.

Camp is owed once a day. Miss it and the party is Fatigued.
